workflowExperience.templateDescription: Read recent candles and publish observations for a downstream script or Agent. This script does not place orders.

workflowExperience.templateRisk: Stop on unavailable market data; never fabricate candles.
workflowExperience.templatePublishDescription: Share the collected data with downstream consumers.

workflowExperience.editStrategyRequest: Help me edit the strategy “{title}”. Requested changes:
workflowExperience.editNodeRequest: Help me edit the “{title}” node in this strategy. Requested changes:
workflowExperience.editGuidance: This is the strategy context for this edit. First use tools to read the strategy and resources identified by strategy_id; read the candidate proposal when proposal_id is non-null, otherwise read the published version, and verify base_revision. Keep the same strategy ID; do not match by name alone or create a different strategy. target identifies the edit target; related_resources is a resource index, not complete source. Read current contents before making changes and report revision mismatches. Use the existing proposal and review workflow; do not automatically enable timers, start the strategy or change trading permissions.
workflowExperience.missingReviewSummary: This record has no readable conclusion. Open the recorded calls to inspect the available evidence.
workflowExperience.changeApplied: This record is marked applied. Assess the effect using subsequent observations.
workflowExperience.proposalRecorded: A candidate proposal was created. Check its status to see whether it has been applied.
workflowExperience.reviewOnly: This is a review recommendation. This record does not provide evidence of an applied change.
workflowExperience.scopeNotRecorded: This record has no file change list.
workflowExperience.expectedOnly: These are expectations from the review, subject to validation and execution evidence.
workflowExperience.validationNotRecorded: No validation outcome was recorded; effectiveness has not been established.

workflowExperience.templateLogic: Read hourly candles and publish observations for downstream consumers.
workflowExperience.templateRationale: Separate market collection from decisions so inputs can be inspected and reused.
